note: Layout recipes written for this project. They abstract recurring patterns seen in professional research decks into parameters of our own compositions and charts; no reference deck's text, artwork, marks or exact composition is reproduced. The design library (private) links its layout archetypes to these ids; the planner (TypeScript) and the agent tools (Python) both read this file.

recipes.name: Chart with a figures rail
recipes.when: One chart carries the message; one hero figure, at most two supporting figures and one short note say what it means.
rules: Action title: the conclusion in one sentence of 16 words or fewer, over the chart columns only.
The rail runs the full height beside the chart, tinted or dark, with a short heading naming what the figures mean.
One hero figure, then at most two supporting figures, each with a label that says what it measures and when.
Rail figures add a level, a change or a gap; the hero may restate the latest level as the focal figure, nothing else is repeated.
Footnote on the paper side, 8 pt, sources and definitions only.

recipes.name: Ranked bars with end values
recipes.when: One metric across many entities at one period, where the focus entity's rank is the message.
rules: Bars sorted by value; the focus bar in the structure colour on a tinted row, every other bar one quiet grey.
Values written at the bar ends; no axis, gridlines or legend.
Rank numerals at the left edge when the rank is the message.
A light panel behind the bars groups them as one exhibit.

recipes.name: Annotated trend with a shaded period
recipes.when: A metric over time for a focus entity against peers, where one period or one extreme carries the message.
rules: Series labelled at their ends with name and latest value; no legend.
The focus series heavy with every point marked; peers thin and quiet.
A light band marks the period the headline is about, labelled with the period only.
One callout at most, on the focus series' extreme, computed from the data.

recipes.name: Agenda with the current section marked
recipes.when: Opening a deck or a section: the sections in order, the one that follows highlighted.
rules: A paper column with the word Contents in the display face; the sections on navy.
Two-digit numerals in the display face; the current section in gold and bold, the others muted.
Section names of five words or fewer; no figures on navigation slides.

recipes.name: Section divider
recipes.when: Between sections of a deck of eight slides or more.
rules: Full navy slide; the section numeral in gold, the section title in the display face, one line saying what the section answers.
No photographs unless licensed for this deck; no figures.

recipes.name: Chart with a commentary column
recipes.when: One chart carries the evidence and three facts explain it; the slide closes on a stated implication.
rules: The exhibit title states the chart's finding; a unit line names measure, unit and period; a charcoal hairline closes the exhibit header.
Three commentary blocks, each a bold lead-in of two to four words and one sentence with its figures; hairlines between blocks.
The conclusion sits at the foot of the column under a heavier rule, level with the chart's baseline.
Figures for the focus entity in the primary colour; peers' figures in charcoal.

recipes.name: Ranked table with a figures column
recipes.when: Many entities compared at two periods, where rank, level and change all matter.
rules: One row per entity, ranked in the message's direction: rank, name, a bar of the latest value with its label, the earlier value, the change.
Charcoal header over a charcoal rule; hairline rows; the focus row tinted, its bar in the primary colour, the others in light grey.
The figures column is tinted and bleeds to the slide edge; the source line keeps to the table side.

recipes.name: Scorecard matrix
recipes.when: Several measures assessed for one entity against a reference, each with level, gap, change and trend.
rules: One numbered row per measure, read left to right: name and unit, focus level, reference level, gap, change, trend, reading.
Focus figures in the primary serif; reference figures in charcoal; sparklines over the same window as the header states.
Every reading is computed; the conclusion row states what the whole matrix shows, under a heavier rule.

recipes.name: Two analytical modules and a figures panel
recipes.when: One subject seen two ways (own change and peer comparison), with the headline figures alongside.
rules: Each module has its own finding-led header and unit line; a hairline divider separates modules.
The focus entity's increment in the primary colour; peers as a benchmark list with flags.
The figures panel carries the lead figure, one supporting figure, the conclusion and at most one motif.

recipes.name: Executive summary on a split background
recipes.when: Three to five findings that together make the case, each with one figure.
rules: The title and a thematic motif in the ivory field; the findings on white.
Each finding: an outlined number, a bold verdict lead-in and one sentence, its figure large in primary serif to the right.
A conclusion under a gold rule.

recipes.name: Causal chain with feedback
recipes.when: The argument is how pressures connect (transmission, debt dynamics, ownership).
rules: Nodes show bound figures; edges carry short verb phrases (words only) stating accounting or institutional links.
One feedback edge routed under the row.
The unit line says the arrows are links, not estimated effects.

languages.institutional: Navy, gold and ivory with a masthead band (PD2)
languages.burgundy: Wine, antique gold and ivory with a title rule and no band (Gate E); colour roles in core/design/language.ts
